Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

SceneSemantics and generated mark/ref/picking properties are implemented and passed the earlier local JVM/JS suites, but current hosted Linux Studio run https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/actions/runs/37366000177 fails SemanticBindingSuite.picking a mark returns its scientific identity. Seed KF-5ODW0Oql7V6UtJPuIz4AYg0y5L9UT29PCS0rUhuM= fails after 5 successes; the reported shrunken scale is 0.0 (InvalidSurface), while ARG_1_ORIGINAL was 2.0. Shrinking has obscured the valid-input original failure, so neither a green local run nor fixing only the final invalid surface establishes acceptance.

Evidence:
- studio/viz/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/plot/SemanticBindingSuite.scala:134
- studio/viz/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/plot/SemanticBindingSuite.scala:143
- studio/viz/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/plot/PlotKit.scala:618

Remaining / next action: Reproduce the exact hosted seed on the original valid scales and preserve the original failure; constrain shrinking to valid scales without weakening the identity/distance assertions, diagnose overlapping-mark/picking behavior, fix the actual defect, and pass the named JVM/JS property and hosted studio gate.

Disposition: Keep open.
